title: SSC CGL Tier II Quant
summary: SSC CGL Tier II Quantitative Aptitude past questions from 12 papers, 2020 to 2026, five a day. Questions SSC asked again and the question types it keeps asking come first, ranked together by how often they were asked, then every other question.
note: Repeats are counted across the Tier II papers only (12 for Quant, 8 for the other sections, CGL 2019 to 2025). Groups were found by a chapter-by-chapter reading (scripts/homework/REVIEW_BRIEF_SSC.md, Tier II section) and checked in the main session. Questions marked defective are left out.
